message:
So `ci->pc` is set to `pc` after fetching the operands for each instruction. When a method call is made, the `pc` is incremented past the call instruction, and `ci->pc` is set to that value. If the call is the last instruction in the iseq, `pc` would point to one past the end.

Let me look at how the call instruction works and how `ci->pc` is used when a new frame is pushed:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "ci->pc" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mruby/src/vm.c | head -40</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
